reviews.comment: His lectures were very interesting! I liked him a lot, He was a harsh grader because he definitely liked things a certain way and he really focused on aesthetics. His two exams were easy, and the papers were very doable because he was accessible outside of class for feedback. If your group sucks for projects then the A is a little bit hard to get.

i took this class as a pre-req, but it was actually really interesting. 2 exams and 2 essays along with presentations every 1-2 weeks. the test were pretty easy if you study, and they were 20 questions each. he gave really good feedback and was accessible out of class. just make sure you do your work and go to class. overall, a great teahcer.

He grades tough and expects you to participate, but he is also really nice and funny, so I recommend taking his class. He emphasizes learning skills like presentation and reading research rather than learning the content, but the content is interesting, too. I highly recommend him and his lectures; he's a really good guy.

literally the greatest professor I've ever had. this class is amazing and jyothis is super funny and a pleasure to listen to. his lectures never get boring and you can tell he cares alot about his students. only 2 essays and a few group projects to worry about, and little review for notes and you're good. best class environment i've been a part of

Your grade is based on only 6 assignments. As long as you put good effort in these few grades, its an easy class. I could've gotten an A had I tried harder. The lectures aren't necessary to pass, but are enjoyable to go to. Overall, a great Prof.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Class had to be moved online half way through semester due to corona virus and he took very good care of us. Was always very clear on what was expected of us and found a way to make me enjoy an incredibly boring class. If it wasn't for jyothis I probably would have dropped the class, but he is far and away the best TA I have ever had!

I took this class the spring semester the Covid-19 outbreak happened. Jyothis in class was funny had thought-provoking discussions and showed that he cared if you learned. When everything moved online he sent an email saying how sad he was that he would not be seeing us again in person. He made online class bearable and more interesting.

Jyothis is the single best TA to get for PHIL482. He gives great feedback on writing assignments and makes recitations interesting. If you have the opportunity to sign up for a class with Jyothis, do it 100%, you won't find a better instructor.

Jyothis is a great TA, he works with you and understands all his students have other obligations. He gives great feedback and makes the assignments easier to understand and sometimes changes them because ENGR 482 does not do a good job with the material.

His grading criteria is insanely hard to follow, I submitted what I thought (and what an English teacher I had read) were very well written papers. I received as he told many of us in class, "abysmally low grades." He isn't an engr so many of the points he thinks will resonate with us don't. IN AN ENGR CLASS I expected an engr to be teaching it
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader
